releases.notes:
First release of **Plugin Read** — a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1 that reads mods & plugins shared by the server, entirely in-game.

## Features

- **In-game browser** — press <kbd>V</kbd> (rebindable) or run `/pluginread` to open the UI
- **Manifest browsing & one-click download** — click any entry to download it, or *Download All*; live per-file progress with percentage
- **Metadata parsing** — automatically reads `fabric.mod.json` / `plugin.yml` / `mods.toml` from downloaded jars and shows type ([Mod] / [Plugin]), name and version
- **SHA-256 verification** — file integrity is checked when the manifest provides a hash
- **Server mod list** — shows the running mod list broadcast by Forge / NeoForge servers via Server List Ping
- **Auto-probe** — common manifest paths on the server host are probed automatically on join; explicit per-server URLs supported in the client config
- **Client commands** — `/pluginread`, `/pluginread refresh`, `/pluginread folder`

Downloaded jars are saved to `.minecraft/pluginread/<server-address>/` and are only stored and parsed — never loaded or executed. No server-side installation required.

## Requirements

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Minecraft | 26.1 |
| Fabric Loader | >= 0.20.1 |
| Fabric API | 0.144.0+26.1 or newer |
| Java | >= 25 |

## Install

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) for Minecraft 26.1
2. Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (0.144.0+26.1 or newer) into your `mods` folder
3. Drop `pluginread-1.0.0.jar` (attached below) into `mods` as well

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XC-Xin-Cheng/pluginread/commits/v1.0.0
